title: 第23章 先天之体第24章 溶骨粉成
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
屋内的设施很简单，只有一个条案，条案的前后各有一张木椅，条案上摆着个茶壶，从上面的灰尘来看，雷校尉至少几个月没有来过这里了！
雷校尉拿过一旁的抹布，擦了擦自己的椅子，坐了上去，然后递给林铭。
“坐！”
林铭也擦了擦另一把椅子，同样是坐了上去，他擦拭的时候，心中思索着的则是这雷校尉到底是找自己什么事情？！
“林铭，你内气大成了吧？！”
雷校尉上下打量着林铭，一开口，就让林铭心中急速流转，想着自己到底是应该如何应对？！
“侥幸！侥幸！”
“侥幸？！”
雷校尉微微一笑，轻声说道：
“别谦虚了，我要是没记错的话，你练武到现在，满打满算才一个多月的时间，就能从一名完全不懂武道的年轻人，成为现在一名内气大成的人物，这可不是侥幸能够得到的……”
林铭确实不是侥幸！
常人很难有他的这般成就！
纵然他克制着吸收武道高手的频率，每天只吸收一人！
这一个多月下来，也吸收了三十多位武道高手的内力，一人能够给他提供一年到三年内力不等，这一个多月的时间，他现在就足足有了四十多年的内力！
“能和我说说，你到底是怎么做到的么？！”
雷校尉询问的时候，依旧是满脸的笑意。
只是林铭从这笑意之中，却体会到了一些不平凡出来！
雷校尉在询问他背后的秘密？！
他要不说……
或许就是一个死字！

怪不得雷校尉要单独将他叫到廨房，这里清静，没什么人过来，也没有人会听到他们的对话，他们说了什么？！就只有他们两人知道！
林铭死后，他的秘密，不会让第三人知道。
战？！
还是逃？！
雷校尉是内气离体的高手，自己内气大成的《金钟罩》到底是不是对方的对手，这还是未知的事情？！
更重要的是，到现在为止，林铭也没有从雷校尉身上感受到一点危险的气息！
他是不是真要灭杀自己，这还仅仅就是林铭的猜测！
林铭的脑海之中念头急转，暗运内力，随时准备发动《金钟罩》和雷校尉拼命。
正当他有所犹豫的时候，雷校尉的声音再度传来。
“别紧张！”
“别误会……”
“我只是有些好奇而已！”
“你若是不想说的话，那完全可以不说！”
“每个人都有秘密，我也一样，有其他人不想知道的事情……”
“你不说，我不会勉强！”
雷校尉越是这么说，林铭心中的警惕之心却更是大了几分。
雷校尉见到，嘴角的笑容更浓了几分。
“真的别紧张，我说的都是实话，今天叫你来这里，询问一下你的武道境界，仅仅是顺便而已，我找你是有其他事情要说……”
“校尉大人！”
林铭没等雷校尉将话说完，打断道：
content_en:
The facilities in the house are very simple. There is only one desk. There is a wooden chair in front of and behind the desk. There is a teapot on the desk. Judging from the dust on it, Lieutenant Lei has not been here for at least a few months!
Lieutenant Lei took the rag on the side, wiped his chair, sat on it, and handed it to Lin Ming.
"Sit!"
Lin Ming also wiped another chair and sat on it. While he was wiping it, he was thinking about what the hell was Captain Lei trying to do with him? !
"Lin Ming, are you full of energy?!"
Lieutenant Lei looked Lin Ming up and down, and as soon as he spoke, Lin Ming's mind raced, wondering how he should respond? !
"Lucky! Lucky!"
"A fluke?!"
Lieutenant Lei smiled slightly and said softly:
"Don't be modest. If I remember correctly, you have been practicing martial arts for just over a month. From a young man who didn't know anything about martial arts, you have become a powerful figure now. This is not something you can get by luck..."
Lin Ming was indeed not a fluke!
It is difficult for ordinary people to have such achievements as him!
Even though he restrains the frequency of absorbing martial arts masters, he only absorbs one person every day!
After more than a month, he has also absorbed the internal energy of more than thirty martial arts masters. One person can provide him with internal energy ranging from one year to three years. In this more than one month, he now has more than forty years of internal energy!
"Can you tell me how you did it?!"
When Lieutenant Lei asked, he still had a smile on his face.
But Lin Ming felt something extraordinary from this smile!
Lieutenant Lei is asking about the secret behind him? !
If he doesn't say...
Maybe it’s just a word for death!
No wonder Lieutenant Lei called him to the dormitory alone. It was quiet here, no one came over, and no one would hear their conversation. What did they say? ! Only the two of them know!
After Lin Ming dies, his secret will not be known to third parties.
war? !
Or run away? !
Lei Xiaowei is a master of inner energy separation from the body. It is still unknown whether the "Golden Bell" with his mastery of inner energy is his opponent? !
More importantly, until now, Lin Ming had not sensed any dangerous aura from Lieutenant Lei!
Whether he really wanted to kill him or not was just Lin Ming's guess!
Lin Ming's thoughts were racing in his mind, and he was secretly channeling his inner strength, ready to activate the "Golden Bell" and fight Captain Lei at any time.
Just when he hesitated, Lieutenant Lei's voice came again.
"Don't be nervous!"
"Don't get me wrong..."
"I'm just a little curious!"
"If you don't want to say it, you don't have to say it at all!"
"Everyone has secrets, and so do I. There are things that others don't want to know..."
"If you don't tell me, I won't force you!"
The more Lieutenant Lei said this, the more vigilant Lin Ming became.
When Lieutenant Lei saw this, the smile on his lips became a little wider.
"Really don't be nervous, I am telling the truth. I called you here today to ask about your martial arts realm, just by the way. I came to see you because I have other things to say..."
"Master Captain!"
Lin Ming interrupted before Captain Lei could finish his words:
